**Traffic Laws in Texas – Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits are the law.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on most highways.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Regulations | | **Seat‑belt & Child Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is illegal.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | TxDOT – Mobile Phone Use | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (BAC ≥ 0.02 %).
• Penalties: fines, license suspension, possible jail. | Texas Alcoholic Beverage Commission (TABC) – DUI | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights.
• “Right‑of‑way” rules for intersections without signs. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Headlights & Lighting** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise, and during rain, fog, or low visibility.
• Fog lights only when visibility < 200 ft. | TxDOT – Headlight Regulations | | **Towing & Vehicle Registration** | • Vehicles must be registered and display valid license plates.
• Towing laws require proper equipment and safe towing practices. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) | | **Parking Rules** | • No parking in fire lanes, handicap spaces (unless you have a permit), or within 20 ft of a crosswalk.
• Parking on sidewalks is prohibited. | TxDOT – Parking Regulations | | **School Bus Laws** | • All vehicles must stop for a school bus with its stop sign extended and lights flashing.
• No passing on either side of a stopped bus. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Use turn signals.
• Do not change lanes in a “no‑change” zone. | TxDOT – Lane‑Changing Rules | | **Traffic Cameras & Enforcement** | • Cameras enforce speed limits, red‑light violations, and other infractions. | TxDOT – Traffic Camera Program | | **Special Vehicle Rules** | • Motorcycles, bicycles, and scooters have specific lane and helmet requirements. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | ### How to Stay Updated - **TxDOT Website** – Official traffic regulations and updates. - **TxDMV** – Registration, licensing, and driver’s handbook. - **Texas Transportation Code** – Full legal text (available online). - **Local County Courts** – For recent traffic case law and penalties. --- #### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas 1. **Always obey posted speed limits** – they’re set for safety. 2. **Keep your seat belt fastened** – it’s a legal requirement and saves lives. 3. **Avoid distractions** – no handheld phone use while driving. 4. **Watch for school buses** – stop immediately when they’re loading/unloading children. 5. **Use headlights** – even on clear days, it improves visibility. If you need more detailed information on a specific law or want to check recent court cases, let me know!
